description: Desktop email, calendar, contacts and task manager
pre_install: $appVersionDir = Get-ChildItem -LiteralPath $appRoot -Directory -Force -ErrorAction Stop | Where-Object { $_.Name -ne 'current' } | Sort-Object CreationTimeUtc -Descending | Select-Object -First 1
if (-not $appVersionDir) { throw 'Could not locate the new Agenoras Scoop version directory.' }
if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $payload -PathType Leaf)) { throw 'Agenoras nested app-64.7z payload was not found in the NSIS extraction.' }
if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0 -or -not (Test-Path -LiteralPath (Join-Path $appDir 'Agenoras.exe') -PathType Leaf)) { throw 'Could not extract the Agenoras application payload.' }

$launcherContent = [string]::Join([Environment]::NewLine, @('@echo off', 'setlocal', 'set "APPDATA=%~dp0data\Roaming"', 'set "LOCALAPPDATA=%~dp0data\Local"', 'if not exist "%APPDATA%" mkdir "%APPDATA%"', 'if not exist "%LOCALAPPDATA%" mkdir "%LOCALAPPDATA%"', 'start "" /D "%~dp0" "%~dp0Agenoras.exe" %*', ''))
notes: The official Windows release is an NSIS installer containing a nested app-64.7z archive. Scoop extracts both layers with 7-Zip; the installer is not executed.
The portable launcher redirects APPDATA and LOCALAPPDATA into the app data folder. Scoop persists this folder under persist\agenoras\data across upgrades.
The original NSIS installer registers Agenoras as a Windows mail app and mailto protocol handler. This portable manifest intentionally does not write those registry associations.
